Primary Workflow The recommended workflow for production deployments is a single bitbake invocation against a board-specific MACHINE that already defines the firmware multiconfig targets. In that case: The platform disk image build starts. Each firmware-bearing image package (for example, openamp-zephyr-demo) is pulled into IMAGE_INSTALL and its multiconfig dependency is queued. The dependent firmware recipe builds under its multiconfig (for example, RPU0 cluster 0 running Zephyr) and produces a deployed binary. The Linux-side packaging recipe installs the binary into /lib/firmware/ inside the rootfs. edf-platform-disk-image assembles the final .wic image with the firmware already in place.
